definitions.explanation: The middle of autumn — in the traditional lunar calendar, the 15th day of the 8th month, corresponding to September or early October in the Gregorian calendar. Strongly associated with moon viewing.

examples.japanese: {中秋|ちゅうしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The mid-autumn moon is especially beautiful.

examples.japanese: {中秋|ちゅうしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名月|めいげつ}→名月：27639_meigetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: We enjoyed the harvest moon as a family.

examples.japanese: {中秋|ちゅうしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ススキ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{月見団子|つきみだんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In mid-autumn there is a custom of offering pampas grass and moon-viewing dumplings.

notes:
⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (middle) + {秋|しゅう} (autumn). A largely literary or formal word; the everyday phrase for the season would be ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{中秋|ちゅうしゅう}{節|せつ} ('Mid-Autumn Festival') is observed across East Asia. In Japan, the {中秋|ちゅうしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名月|めいげつ}→名月：27639_meigetsu⟧ (harvest moon) is the centerpiece of ⟦{月見|つきみ}→月見：13001_tsukimi⟧ (moon viewing), traditionally celebrated with pampas grass ({薄|すすき}) and {月見団子|つきみだんご} (round moon-viewing dumplings).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中秋|ちゅうしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名月|めいげつ}→名月：27639_meigetsu⟧: harvest moon
- {中秋|ちゅうしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}: around mid-autumn
- {中秋節|ちゅうしゅうせつ}: Mid-Autumn Festival

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{初秋|しょしゅう}→初秋：26026_shoshuu⟧: early autumn
- ⟦{晩秋|ばんしゅう}→晩秋：08561_banshuu⟧: late autumn
- {仲秋|ちゅうしゅう}: alternate writing meaning specifically the 8th lunar month
